topic.source_contract: waste need, hierarchy, facility type, planning status, environmental permit, operator competence, monitoring and delivery evidence

scope_guards: A waste allocation is not treated as planning permission.
Planning permission is not treated as an environmental permit.
An environmental permit is not treated as evidence that construction is complete.
A waste hierarchy statement is not treated as verified diversion performance.
A permit application is not treated as a granted or effective permit.
A registered exemption is not treated as authorisation for activities outside its limits.
A recovery plan is not treated as completed recovery or restored land.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, permission, permit, operator, construction, commissioning and compliance evidence.
row_checks: Current waste local plan and policies required
Exact waste types and codes required
Current arisings, capacity and gap evidence required
Prevention, reuse, recycling, recovery and disposal sequence required
Transfer, treatment, recovery and disposal separated
Realistic spatial market and transport catchment required
Exact allocation boundary and status required
Current application and red-line boundary required
Current decision, conditions and expiry required
Exact permit number, operator and activity required
Granted, varied, transferred, suspended or surrendered status required
Legal operator and competence evidence required
Permitted waste list and acceptance procedures required
Air, water, noise, odour and dust controls required
Applicable fire prevention plan and controls required
Vehicle numbers, routes and highway controls required
Nearby facilities and sensitive receptors required
Afteruse, phasing, security and aftercare required
Built facility and completion evidence required
Current inspections and compliance history required
